name: MineXray
description: X-ray and ESP for singleplayer. Right Shift opens it: Classic X-Ray (X), Ore ESP with whole veins, labels and tracers (G), Cave Finder, Fluid View, Lava Warning, Block ESP (chests, spawners, portals...), Entity ESP, a block editor for every block, presets that switch per dimension, a vein scanner and a HUD. Off on multiplayer servers unless you allow it in Settings. Also part of MineMeBoostXray. In English and Portuguese (Portugal).
